rows.Name: Category field applicability
rows.Source basis: Every category row lists key_fields; no explicit visible_when column.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Show category-specific fields listed for the exact selected full path; do not automatically remove existing common listing fields.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Keep old record values until reviewed transition; never silently persist inapplicable new values.
rows.Validation note: Unspecified requiredness remains unresolved. Existing draft/submit rules are independent.

rows.Name: Vehicle brand/model dependency
rows.Source basis: Car and two-wheeler catalogues both have brand/model; no dropdown behaviour is supplied.
rows.Proposed behaviour: For covered vehicle groups, filter models by selected brand and explicit catalogue/type mapping. Keep visible but disabled until a parent is selected or while loading.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Vehicle group and brand selected; lookup loaded successfully.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Changing brand/type invalidates an incompatible model after confirmation.
rows.Validation note: Check model belongs to selected brand/type on server; do not apply universally to Goods.

rows.Name: Confirm category/parent changes
rows.Source basis: Not specified by CSV; preserves the agreed Post Ad interaction.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Confirm removal of incompatible child/category details; retain unrelated common values.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: No save in flight; action permitted by current form state.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Do not delete legacy saved values merely because a newer rule hides an input.
rows.Validation note: Compute allowed values from approved category/version server-side; client state is not authority.
rows.Source / provenance: Proposal; project behaviour, not a CSV claim

rows.Name: Electric motorcycle/scooter fields
rows.Source basis: Electric rows omit engine_cc and list range_km/battery_warranty_left.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Use the exact electric leaf key_fields for applicability; do not add battery_capacity_kwh from the car row.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Electric leaf chosen; normal draft field state.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Clear incompatible new values only through confirmed transitions.
rows.Validation note: Do not treat every non-electric motorcycle as Petrol; CNG exists in the supplied catalogue.

rows.Name: Property amount basis
rows.Source basis: Source separately names price, monthly_rent, monthly_rent_per_bed, monthly_rent_per_seat and rent_per_night.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Preserve the leaf-specific amount label/basis. Model primary amount and period/unit separately from negotiability.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Applicable Property leaf; validated amount contract ready before persistence.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Changing sale/rent/basis must not silently reinterpret an existing amount.
rows.Validation note: Money limits/precision and requiredness need approved DB/API rules.

rows.Name: Avoid duplicate canonical fields
rows.Source basis: CSV repeats price, condition, city/locality and uses title for books/games.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Map compatible common concepts once; keep title ambiguous until ad-title vs product-title meaning is approved.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Canonical mapping reviewed; otherwise preview unresolved control.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Do not overwrite canonical data from a duplicate attribute.
rows.Validation note: One validated persistence authority per concept.

rows.Name: Boolean unanswered versus false
rows.Source basis: Keys such as bill_available, box_available and food_included suggest yes/no; source has no types/defaults.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Use unanswered/yes/no while drafting rather than treating untouched as false.
rows.Validation note: Do not mark a field required merely because it appears in key_fields.

rows.Name: No automatic status-to-availability mapping
rows.Source basis: Cars use on_sale/discontinued/import_only; bikes use Current/Discontinued/Upcoming.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Preserve raw statuses and track independently from selectable/released flags. Retain discontinued models as reference for used listings.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Catalogue rule approved; Upcoming/import_only require review rather than silent enablement.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Never remove a saved model because its market status changed.
rows.Validation note: No current manufacturer/availability verification is claimed.

rows.Name: Separate availability and input state
rows.Source basis: No per-field is_visible/is_enabled/required_when columns are supplied.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Keep category visibility/new-listing eligibility separate from field visible_when, enabled_when, required_when and stale-value policy.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Compiled policy valid; unknown rules are not permission.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Hidden/disabled is presentation, not authorization or automatic data deletion.
rows.Validation note: Revalidate submitted values on server and enforce ownership through RLS.

rows.Name: Catalogue values are suggestions
rows.Source basis: Bike rows have one engine_cc/fuel_type per model; car rows omit fuel_type/year/variant.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Label defaults as catalogue hints, not immutable vehicle specifications. Do not infer year/variant or car powertrain from model text.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Relevant source data exists and applicability is reviewed.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Missing engine remains null/unknown, never zero.
rows.Validation note: Seller confirmation and approved per-year/variant overrides need a later contract.
rows.Source / provenance: Vehicle CSV headers; missing engine rows

rows.Name: India-first display order
rows.Source basis: Taxonomy file lists Cars before Motorcycles and Scooters; user direction is two-wheelers first.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Preserve source order in evidence. Use an explicit separate display order: Motorcycles, Scooters, Cars, Bicycles, Vehicle Parts & Accessories, Commercial Vehicles.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Ordering affects display only, not release status.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: No source-row relabelling or historical listing reassignment.
rows.Validation note: All source groups remain represented; business scope is approved separately.

rows.Name: Empty versus failed dependent lookup
rows.Source basis: Behaviour is not specified by CSV.
rows.Proposed behaviour: Show an error for failed model loads and a distinct empty state for zero matching models; do not choose the first or fabricate a fallback.
rows.Enabled when - PROPOSED: Successful nonempty result; controlled Not listed option requires explicit proposal.
rows.Hidden/stale values - PROPOSED: Retain user input on network failure.
rows.Validation note: Do not create selectable IDs for missing catalogue entries.
rows.Source / provenance: Architectural proposal, not a CSV claim
